# https://ekvanservices.co.uk

## About
EK Van Services is a local van hire and clearance company based in East Kilbride, covering Glasgow and all surrounding areas.

## Contact
- Phone / WhatsApp: 07832655209 (+447832655209)
- Area: East Kilbride, Glasgow, South Lanarkshire, Scotland, UK

## Services
- House Clearances: Fast and efficient full property clearances.
- Furniture Delivery: Safe collection and delivery of furniture and large items.
- Man with a Van: Flexible, reliable transport for moves of any size.
- Rubbish Removal: Responsible waste disposal for homes and businesses.
- General Handyman: Odd jobs and property maintenance.

## Coverage
East Kilbride (base), Glasgow, Hamilton, Rutherglen, Cambuslang, Motherwell, Paisley, Lanark, Wishaw, Blantyre, Uddingston, Larkhall, and surrounding areas.

Slogan: "Reliable Van. Reliable Service."
